title.note: Game title, kept byte-identical per the glossary (brand, no official French title).

hud.reel.note: Fishing sense: 'remonter la ligne / le poisson'; 8/8. 'Mouliner' is the angler's word but younger kids may not know it; 'Ferrer' means setting the hook, not reeling in. Same verb as the pass 'Remontée auto'.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form, correct for 0, 1 and more (French would need '1 appât' vs '2 appâts').

hud.backpack.note: Guide vocabulary (inventaire / sac). 'Sac à dos' (9) also fits, but the short label reads cleaner on a HUD button.

catch.success.note: Colon and parentheses so no article or adjective has to agree with the inserted fish (Carpe dorée and Anguille-lanterne are feminine); rarity tags Rare / Légendaire / Mythique are epicene. 19/30 without params; filled: 'Tu as pêché : Carpe dorée (Rare) !'.

catch.escaped.note: Names the generic 'poisson' (m.) rather than 'Il', since the species on the line may be feminine (carpe, anguille).

catch.new_record.note: Developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; French writes '12,4'. Format the number per locale if possible.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Modeled on the real French name 'poisson-lanterne' (lanternfish), keeping the glowing-lantern idea; 17/18. Feminine, but no string puts an article or adjective next to it.

shop.rods.note: 'Cannes à pêche' (14) is over 10; in a fishing shop tab 'Cannes' alone is unambiguous.

shop.equipped.note: State label, feminine to agree with 'canne', the only item it marks.

shop.buy_robux.note: 19/20 without {price}. If 4-digit prices overflow, 'Payer {price} Robux' is the shorter fallback. Developer: French writes thousands as '1 000', not '1,000'.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel (Remonter); 13/14. 'Moulinet auto' is the alternative if the developer prefers the reel-device image. The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: L'Appât de chance double tes chances de pêcher des poissons rares !
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name from the glossary words chance (luck) + appât (bait), like the guide's 'Potion de chance'; the elided article stays outside the bold tag.

sell.done.note: Two label forms so 1 fish or 1 coin reads right (no '1 poissons', '1 pièces'). 39/40 without numbers.

sell.prompt.note: 'Appuie sur E pour vendre' is 24 > 21; same pattern as the guide's 'E pour ouvrir'. E sits in the same place on AZERTY. Source-side: phone and console players have no E key; ActionText 'Vendre' alone would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: No natural French infinitive for this prestige reset ('S'élever' reads spiritual or like climbing), so the noun names the mechanic, 9/10. 'Prestige' is the alternative if the developer prefers it.

ascend.confirm.text: Lancer l'ascension maintenant ? Tu repartiras de zéro, mais tu pêcheras des poissons rares {bonus} % plus souvent.
ascend.confirm.note: Same word as the button; lowercase in the sentence so it reads as the game action, not the religious feast (l'Ascension). 'repartir de zéro' = start over.

weather.storm.text: Une tempête approche ! Les poissons rares mordent.

quest.catch_n.note: Label form so n = 1 reads right (no '1 poissons'); 40/40. Moonlit Bay -> 'Baie Clair-de-Lune' (moonlight, place-name style). The more fluent 'Poissons à pêcher à la Baie Clair-de-Lune : {n}' is 44 if the line has room.

friends.boost.text: Pêcher avec tes amis donne +{percent} % de chance

trade.accept.note: avoir-participle, so no agreement with the player's unknown gender; 'ton échange' = your trade request.

codes.redeemed.text: Code validé ! Profite de ta récompense.
codes.redeemed.note: 'Code validé' is the usual French game wording for a redeemed code.

afk.kicked.text: Tu as été AFK trop longtemps, alors ta pêche s'est arrêtée.
afk.kicked.note: AFK (kept per guide) instead of 'inactif / inactive', which would need the player's gender; 'as été' takes no agreement. No mention of being removed from the server, as in the source.

event.ends.note: Developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; French expects '2 j 4 h'. Format durations per locale if possible.

daily.streak.text: Jour {day} de ta série ! Reviens demain pour d'autres récompenses.
daily.streak.note: 'Jour {day} de ta série' avoids a plural for day = 1; 'série' is the usual French word for a login streak. 'for more' made explicit as rewards, per context. 60/62.

tip.night.text: Astuce : certains poissons ne mordent que la nuit.

group.join.note: Roblox calls groups 'communautés'; 'offerts' is the French promo word for free (guide: '... offerte !').

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'gros' = heavy for a fish, 'prise' = a catch (noun); 17/18.
